text.title: Karim's Big Day
body: Last Friday, our school organised a small ceremony for the best students of the term.
My friend Karim was very nervous before his name was called.
When the headmaster said "Karim Belaïd," the whole class cheered loudly.
Karim walked to the front carefully and shook the headmaster's hand.
He looked proud and slightly embarrassed at the same time.
Afterwards, our teacher gave a short speech about hard work and kindness.
She said that success is not only about grades, but also about helpfulness towards others.
Karim later told me that he wanted to become a doctor one day.
I think his happiness that day will stay in his memory for a long time.
The whole event lasted about forty-five minutes.
